Before payment, they were very polite and responsive, but once the money was received, their attitude completely changed.

Despite multiple follow-ups and polite requests, the owner kept making excuses and finally stopped responding to my messages and calls. This shows a serious lack of professionalism and honesty. ₹1000 may not be a big amount for some, but it clearly reflects how they treat tenants and handle commitments.

If you are looking for a genuine and transparent PG, I strongly advise you to avoid this place. Always ask for written confirmation or receipts before paying any advance here — otherwise, you might end up being cheated like me.

Highly disappointed with such unethical behavior. I hope others don’t face the same issue.
